faq.answer: AIM-Ami offers three main services: **AI Project Consultancy** (a retainer for AI architecture, automation, and implementation), **Creator Protection** (monthly security for creators, from $9), and **Small Business Digital Protection** (monthly security for businesses). See them all in [Services](index.html#services).

**Creator Protection** has two plans. **Essential** is $9 a month with no setup fee (monthly checklist, impersonation checks, scam alerts, self-guided protection, monthly digest). **Plus** is $19 a month plus a $29 one-time onboarding fee and adds two personal security reviews a year, a quarterly exposure review, and priority incident guidance. Details are in [Services](index.html#services). Add-ons for either plan: social media handle setup and automated messaging workflows.

**Small Business Digital Protection** covers email and domain reviews, employee account checklists, access reviews, phishing guidance, a monthly status report, and defined incident support. Pricing is custom by business size, with an onboarding assessment starting at $99. See [Services](index.html#services) or [contact us](index.html#contact) for a quote.

**AI Project Consultancy** is a retainer for ongoing AI work: AI architecture and solutions, workflow automation, technical customer success management, prompt engineering, implementation guidance, and business optimization analysis. Pricing is scope-based, and add-ons include new channels and more workflows. See [Services](index.html#services).
The **discovery call** is 25 minutes for a $29 booking fee. The fee secures your time and is credited toward any service you purchase within 30 days. You can [book it here](index.html#contact).
There are three free guides in the shop: the **AI starter guide**, the **Prompt cheat sheet**, and the **AI security checklist**. Grab them in [Freebies](shop.html#freebies).

Free lessons live on [YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/@AIM-Ami). Paid courses (AI in entrepreneurship, AI prompting and architecture, language learning with AI, and using AI to grow) are coming soon. See [Courses](shop.html#courses).
We host **workshops and webinars** and a **masterclass**. Dates are still to be announced, but you can sign up now in [Events](index.html#events) and we will send details.
The [shop](shop.html) has free guides now, and digital products (security policy templates and prompt packs) and courses are coming soon.
You can reach us through the [contact form](index.html#contact) or at helloaimami@gmail.com. To chat with a person, tap **Talk to a person** below.

Pricing: Creator Essential $9 a month (no setup fee), Creator Plus $19 a month ($29 onboarding), Small Business protection is custom (onboarding from $99), consulting is scope-based, and the discovery call is a $29 booking fee credited toward services within 30 days. See [Services](index.html#services).
AIM-Ami was founded by **Jay Sodhi**, your AI solutions guy, who has 10+ years in the industry. Learn more in [About](index.html#about).
